flow.title: How Ordo Works
flow.desc: Ordo processes requests with incredible speed and precision. Here's a glimpse into the execution flow.
flow.workspace_title: Projects, Rules, and Tests. In One Workspace.
flow.layer_projects_desc: Keep org, team, and project context visible while you edit a ruleset.
flow.layer_rules_desc: Switch between rule files and author branching logic visually in the canvas.
flow.layer_tests_desc: Validate expected outputs without leaving the workspace or opening another tool.

benchmarks.title: Benchmark Results
benchmarks.description: Single-thread tests on Apple Silicon (M-series) show Ordo's exceptional performance far exceeding industry standards.
benchmarks.chart_note: * ~600x performance boost, making real-time business decisions invisible.
benchmarks.modes_desc: From development debugging to extreme performance needs, Ordo covers all scenarios.
benchmarks.mode_treewalk_desc: Direct interpretation, perfect for development and one-off rules.
benchmarks.mode_vm_desc: High-efficiency bytecode, default for production, balances flexibility and speed.
benchmarks.mode_vectorized_desc: Columnar batch processing, massive throughput for large-scale data validation.
benchmarks.mode_jit_desc: Compiles to native machine code, compressing latency to nanoseconds.
benchmarks.jit_desc: Compiles numeric rules to native machine code via Cranelift. 20–30x faster than the bytecode VM in compute-heavy scenarios.

features.title: Why Ordo?
features.description: Most teams start with a rule engine. The hard part isn't execution — it's knowing what rules exist, who changed them, and whether they still work.
features.editor_desc: Drag-and-drop flow editor, decision tables, and one-click template instantiation. Author rules without writing JSON by hand.
features.performance_desc: Sub-microsecond execution, Cranelift JIT compilation. Runs as HTTP · gRPC · WASM · CLI or embedded in Rust — fast enough that you never think about it.
features.wasm_desc: Create, run, and export test suites per ruleset. CI-compatible YAML format. Know your rules work before they ship.
features.audit_desc: Typed decision contracts, full version history, and audit logging. Roll back a ruleset in one click. Track every change.
features.tenant_desc: Org & project management, fact catalog, and rule templates. One place for your team to own, discover, and manage all decision logic.
features.filter_desc: Push rule logic into your database. Generates SQL WHERE clauses, JSON predicates, or MongoDB $match stages — no full-table scans, no row-by-row evaluation.
features.integration_desc: Single binary server, browser via WebAssembly, embedded in Rust apps. HTTP REST, gRPC, or Unix socket — one engine for every deployment target.
features.usecase_finance_desc: Handle routing matrices, approval policies, and result fields in a table view that operators can review without reading raw JSON.
features.usecase_ecommerce_desc: Start from built-in or GitHub templates, inspect the sample, and create a project from a proven ruleset in a few clicks.
features.usecase_routing_desc: Inspect registered engines, health, and metrics inline so the team can see where rules are running before shipping changes.

code.title: Easy to Define, Seconds to Execute
code.desc: Ordo uses intuitive JSON/YAML formats. Supports rich expression syntax including math, logic, and built-in functions. Get decision results and detailed trace in microseconds via simple API calls.
code.step1_desc: Define step flow and decision logic

editor.title: Template-First Studio
editor.desc: Browse ready-made examples from the marketplace, create a project from the right template, and keep tests close while you adapt it.
editor.view_multi_desc: Seamlessly switch between Flow and Form views to fit different editing habits.
editor.view_wasm_desc: Get identical results to server-side execution instantly in browser using WASM.
editor.view_trace_desc: Visually trace every node in rule execution to make debugging effortless.

cta.title: Own your decision logic.
cta.desc: Stop scattering business rules across codebases and spreadsheets. Ordo gives your team one place to author, test, and govern them. Open source on GitHub.

footer.desc: Open-source decision platform — author, test, and govern business rules at scale.

integration.title: Comprehensive Integration
integration.desc: Ordo offers multiple integration methods, perfectly adapting to microservices, browser-side, or local high-performance scenarios.
integration.deploy_desc: Ordo supports all scenarios from cloud microservices to browser edge nodes.
integration.invoke_desc: Standardized protocols ensuring rapid response across any technology stack.
integration.method_cloud_desc: Deploy via Docker/K8s/Nomad, serving rules via HTTP/gRPC.
integration.method_edge_desc: Execute directly in browser or edge nodes via WASM, zero latency.
integration.method_embedded_desc: Compile directly into your Rust application for zero-overhead integration.
